name: Eigenvalue Property Substitution
description: Replaces the subset-sum capacity formula with a system of linear equations that has a non-trivial solution if and only if the subset's adjacency matrix has an eigenvalue of 2. For a 3-vertex subgraph, this is only possible if it is 2-regular (a triangle). This defeats models that rely on surface pattern matching, forcing them to mathematically deduce the 2-regularity requirement to avoid an O(N^3) brute-force linear solver.
